description: A modular Minecraft Fabric plugin for version 1.(20|21).1 that lets four teams compete on unique elemental islands, featuring dynamic disasters, team-based bonuses, and a creative PvP competition system.

mods.name: Stormbound Isles
mods.description: Explore the mystical Stormbound Isles: new islands filled with dangers, rare resources, and ancient secrets that take your Minecraft adventure to a whole new level!
